Start with the expanded examples. Open further examples for options and alternative R approaches.

invweibullph

Find a PH Weibull percentile

Stata 

display invweibullph(2,0.5,0.9)

R stats 

stats::qweibull(0.9, shape=2, scale=0.5^(-1/2))

Stata reference · R reference

invweibullphtail

Find a PH Weibull upper-tail quantile

Stata 

display invweibullphtail(2,0.5,0.1)

R stats 

stats::qweibull(0.1, shape=2, scale=0.5^(-1/2), lower.tail=FALSE)

Stata reference · R reference

lncauchyden

Evaluate a Cauchy log density

Stata

R stats 

stats::dcauchy(3, location=1, scale=2, log=TRUE)

Stata reference · R reference

lnigammaden

Evaluate an inverse-gamma log density

Stata 

display lnigammaden(3,2,4)

R stats 

stats::dgamma(1/4,shape=3,rate=2,log=TRUE)-2*log(4)

Differs from Stata Uses the reciprocal-gamma change of variables with its log-Jacobian. Match Stata shape and scale parameterization; numerical tail underflow can differ.

Stata reference · R reference

lnmvnormalden

Evaluate a multivariate normal log density

Stata 

matrix M = (0,0)
matrix V = I(2)
matrix X = (1,2)
display lnmvnormalden(M,V,X)

R mvtnorm 

mvtnorm::dmvnorm(x=c(1,2),mean=c(0,0),sigma=diag(2),log=TRUE)

Differs from Stata Fixed example uses mean M=(0,0), covariance V=I(2), and evaluation vector X=(1,2).

npnF

Solve a noncentral F probability for noncentrality

Stata 

display npnF(4,20,2,0.5)

R stats 

stats::uniroot(function(ncp) stats::pf(2,df1=4,df2=20,ncp=ncp)-0.5,c(0,50),tol=1e-10)$root

Differs from Stata Numerically inverts the noncentral F CDF over the displayed bracket. Other inputs can require a different bracket; solver tolerances differ from Stata.

Stata reference · R reference

npnchi2

Solve a noncentral chi-squared probability for noncentrality

Stata 

display npnchi2(4,8,0.5)

R stats 

stats::uniroot(function(ncp) stats::pchisq(8,df=4,ncp=ncp)-0.5,c(0,50),tol=1e-10)$root

Differs from Stata Numerically inverts the noncentral chi-square CDF over the displayed noncentrality bracket. Other inputs may need a wider bracket; Stata performs its own domain validation and inversion.

Stata reference · R reference

npnt

Solve a noncentral t probability for noncentrality

Stata 

display npnt(20,2,0.5)

R stats 

stats::uniroot(function(ncp) stats::pt(2,df=20,ncp=ncp)-0.5,c(0,4),tol=1e-10)$root

Differs from Stata Numerically inverts the noncentral t CDF over the displayed bracket. Negative or larger noncentralities require different bounds; solver tolerances differ from Stata.

Stata reference · R reference
